title: Backward rewind of the replay machine
statement: Let $x$ and $w$ be Boolean words, let $p$ be an input-head position for $x$, let $out$ be an output word, and let $j$ be a natural number with $j\le |w|$. Starting with the replay machine in rewind state at work-tape head position $j-1$, it reaches after $j+1$ steps the emitting state with the same buffer $w$, output $out$, and work-tape head at position zero; the input-head position remains $p$.
replaced: For every input word, input position, buffer $w$, output, and count $j \le |w|$, running the replay machine in its rewind control at cell $j - 1$ for $j + 1$ steps restores the buffer head to zero and enters the emitting control; each occupied prefix cell is read once and the empty-buffer case is included.
